company.name: Ashby
company.shortDescription: Ashby develops human resource software to assist companies with hiring and manpower management.
company.description: Ashby operates as a developer of recruitment software used for high-growth companies. It develops usable, enterprise-grade employment software that enables company leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to run their hiring process significantly better.

productsAndServices.description: An integrated recruiting software combining ATS, scheduling, CRM, sourcing, and analytics to manage hiring processes for companies of all sizes.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby All-in-one Recruiting Platform

productsAndServices.description: A recruiting analytics tool that provides customizable reports, dashboards, and insights to track hiring metrics and support data-driven decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A sourcing and candidate relationship management tool that helps recruiters find, engage, and track candidates using search, outreach sequences, and AI assistance.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby Sourcing & CRM

productsAndServices.description: A scheduling tool that automates interview booking, manages complex calendars, and provides self-serve booking links to streamline candidate and interviewer coordination.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby Scheduling

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered tool that automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes interview calls, integrating notes directly into Ashby workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby AI Notetaker (Upcoming)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven interviewing tool embedded in Ashby that runs structured screening conversations and feeds results into hiring workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Ashby AI Interviewer

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $50,000,000, or 41.66% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,800,467 to $661,765,365, a 47.95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-21).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Paradox, Lever, Mercor.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
